primary_retrieval_subset: all12 preregistered risk queries; other12 descriptive boundary group
baseline: original query BM25/BGE top100 then equal RRF60 top100
experimental: original+static lexical auxiliary query; equal within-modality RRF60 top100 then equal cross-modality RRF60 top100
rerank_rules: same existing ME rules, same adjacent source context, deduplicate exact query+unit text tasks across arms
qrels: blind full-document reading on shared Top20 source-file pool
qrels_quality: same-family model silver, not expert gold
adoption: primary Top1 and MRR must not decrease; at least one must improve; examine candidate loss and wrong mechanism before recommending broader deployment
